bio: As the House Administrator I am responsible for room reservations, House finances, weekly newsletters, administrative tasks and daily operations. I work with the House team to host a variety of programs and events, such as Music & Mingles and Faculty Dean Open Houses. I also manage housing assignments for all Winthrop residents. I have worked within Higher Education, specifically within Residential Life departments for the past 10 years. I joined the Winthrop House team September 2019. Prior to arriving at Harvard, I was at Brandies University managing on-campus housing processes and assignments. I have a background in graphic design, art education, and sports leadership. Outside of work I like to spend time with my family, play basketball, read (mystery, sci-fi, historical fiction), and attempt to learn a new language.
